raw.chosen: Classify MountMultiPathUnsupportedError as TS-only within setup errors
raw.reasoning: Python exposes no mount launcher or env bag and its mount placeholders always raise ts_only_sdk_feature; no Go or Swift SDK launcher exists in this repo. Only the TypeScript launcher can pass RELAYFILE_MOUNT_PATHS_FILE to the daemon.

retrospective.summary: Declared the public TypeScript-only launcher refusal in SDK parity with the capability reason; contract, build, typecheck, and 235 SDK tests pass.
